name: University of Kentucky
tuition_note: In-state (KY resident) undergraduate tuition & fees 2026-27 = $7,088.50/semester x 2 = $14,177 from studentaccount.uky.edu/tuition-and-fees/undergraduate-tuition-and-fees (cost-of-attendance page rounds to $14,178). Housing is room only: base residence hall rate $4,510/semester x 2 = $9,020/year (2026-27) from wildcatliving.uky.edu/residence-halls/rates; dining/meal plans excluded. Room rates range $9,020-$13,232/yr by room type. Note: UK's cost-of-attendance page lists a combined food+housing figure of $17,048.
